about_the_game:
PeopleBOX is your own personal sandbox where you craft civilization however you want.

Gather interest groups or assemble them for some epic purposes. You can put together factory worker squads, sales teams in stores, or student groups at university. And if you're up for some action, create a team of archaeologists digging up ancient mysteries right in your world. 🔍

Create your own activities from 80+ types of actions. Want them to worship microwaves or hold origami folding competitions all the time? Easy! 📦✂️

Add any needs and skills to people. Maybe everyone has a craving for grilled cheese sandwiches or a skill for talking to plants? 🥪🌱

Mold your people however you want. If you want to create a world where everyone worships green tea and goes to extreme bowling lessons, why not? Build a civilization around tea and bowling! 🍵🎳

Shuffle furniture as you please. You can create a chair that satisfies one's sense of self-importance or a table that writes poetry by itself. Or add something more complicated than chairs and tables, but if your peeps don't get why they need it, they'll turn it into a bonfire. Or worse. 🔥🪑

Economy? You're the chief economist here. You can make everyone work hard for corn dogs. Or set up inflation where the most valuable resource is dolls, becoming more expensive and rarer than even nuclear reactors. 🌭💰

Restrictions? Sure thing. You can forbid everyone from stealing except for one chosen thief who steals only road signs. Or prohibit everyone except pensioners from throwing parties, so the rest can envy. 🚫🎉

Housing? You decide where everyone lives. Want to create a utopian city without property where everyone sleeps on communal beds, or on the flip side, everyone gets a house with their own vertical garden farm and a pinball machine. 🏠🌿

In PeopleBOX, you're a god, a dictator, and the chief architect all in one. Create, destroy, and don't forget about anchovy pizza! 🏗💥🍕

Forget about templates, here you decide who hangs out in your world, from career-driven folks to obsessed geeks. You can make them dream about anchovy pizza for life and pursue a career in looksmaxxing. Why not?
